summary.text: Karla May, a Democrat, represents Missouri Senate District 4, covering part of the City of St. Louis and nearby communities, and was sworn in on January 9, 2019.
She is the Minority Caucus chair and previously served eight years in the Missouri House, representing District 84.

paragraphs.text: May was born and raised in the City of St. Louis and holds an ASBA from Forest Park Community College and a BSBA from Saint Louis University.
She has been employed with AT&T for 25 years.
She was first elected to the Missouri House in 2010 and served on the Budget and Transportation committees.

She formerly served as vice chair of the Missouri General Assembly's Black Legislative Caucus and as treasurer of the bipartisan Missouri Women's Legislative Caucus, and was Region XI chair of the National Black Caucus of State Legislators from 2012 to 2018.
May is president and board member of the St. Louis Philanthropic Organization and an executive board member of the Coalition of Black Trade Unionists St. Louis Chapter.
She has served as youth minister at Grow 2 Go Christian Center since October 2001.
